title: Bring your own release artifacts

scenes.heading: The release knows the exact bytes
scenes.sub: Keep artifact identities with the publisher
voice: A publisher knows the exact chart and image it released.
An artifact inventory lets that publisher supply those identities separately from the catalog that describes a cluster.

scenes.heading: Map the release to a component
scenes.result: Chart and image select their targets
voice: Chart bindings map inventory entries to recipe components.
Image bindings identify which chart value holds the digest, so the recipe can carry the publisher’s exact image identity.

scenes.heading: Inspect the recorded provenance
scenes.sub: Resolve the recipe with the bindings
voice: Resolve the recipe with the matching inventory and bindings.
AICR records the input digests and applied identities so an operator can trace what the recipe selected.

scenes.heading: Replay with the same inputs
voice: The bundle captures the external inputs used for resolution.
To reuse the saved recipe for bundling or validation, provide the same inputs so their provenance can be checked.

payoff: Bind an exact chart and image release into the selected recipe, then inspect its recorded artifact provenance.
